Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand Redwood's serving model and the cost/latency tradeoffs. A quick recap from our side and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

- Team: myself (Samantha, Director of ML Platform) and Oliver Park (CTO) were on the call.

2) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) to unblock procurement and SOW conversations.

For (1) our engineers are available next week in the windows below (PDT):
- Tue 7/6: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 7/7: 09:00–11:00

For (2) Oliver is generally available mornings next week (PDT); if you can propose a couple of 30–45 min windows that would be great. Also would appreciate any pre-read (slides or short SOW draft).

Thanks — looking forward to the next call.

Best,
